Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law Shuk-pui said on Saturday that authorities were conducting feasibility studies on upgrading the popular tennis facility in Causeway Bay and hoped to begin work within the time frame covered by the city’s new five-year... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
